notes: Heritage communities (docs/ONE_CHARACTER_PLAN.md R13). Fictional heritages: a name for the settings screen, a cuisine, a festival and the tag of the community shops. A heritage is inherited from the parents like a look, but it is NOT tied to the look and it NEVER sets income, wages, hiring, justice, crime or the roughness of a district (tools/heritage_guard.ps1 greps the money, career, justice, crime and district scripts for the word). It only gives a soft pull when people choose where to live: relatives, friends and the community shops nearby.
